statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (h a : ℝ) (t : (Fin n → Fin m) → Set (V n)), 0 ≤ h → 0 ≤ a → (∀ f, Metric.ediam (t f) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt n*h)) → (∑ f, Metric.ediam (t f)^a) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((m:ℝ)^n * (Real.sqrt n*h)^a)
proof:
intro m h a t hh ha ht
calc
  (∑ f, Metric.ediam (t f)^a) ≤ ∑ _f : Fin n → Fin m, (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt n*h))^a := by
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun f _ => ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow (ht f) ha
  _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((m:ℝ)^n * (Real.sqrt n*h)^a) := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (by positivity) ha]
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
    simp
